apps.title: Apps
apps.emptyHint: Connect an MCP server to give agents tools.

auth.oauth_code: OAuth authorization code (each user signs in)

form.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 24 characters. Leave empty to derive it from the name.
form.urlHelp: The MCP endpoint, for example https://example.com/mcp

ownershipHelp.org: One credential set by an admin is used for everyone.
ownershipHelp.personal: Every member fills in their own credential before using the app.

credentialHint.org: Organization credential (optional now; you can set it later on the app page).
credentialHint.personal: Your own credential (optional now; you can set it later in My connections).

tools.missing: No longer provided by the server
tools.neverReviewed: Never reviewed: approve it on the Review tab to enable it

credential.title: Credential
credential.orgHint: Enter a new value to replace the stored credential.
credential.orgReadonly: Only admins can change the organization credential.
credential.personalHint: Each member sets their own credential in My connections.
credential.oauthOrgHint: This app signs in with an OAuth client; the organization token is obtained automatically.
credential.clientDcr: This app's client was registered automatically and cannot be replaced; reinstall the app to change it.
credential.rotateVerified: The new client is verified by obtaining a token first; nothing changes if that fails.
credential.rotateUnverified: The new client is not verified. If it is wrong, every member has to reconnect.

settings.title: General
settings.deleteHint: Agents that use this app lose its tools, and stored credentials are removed. This cannot be undone.

oauth.clientSecretHelp: Leave empty for a public client.
oauth.scopesHelp: Space separated; leave empty for the server default.

wizard.title: Install app

connectorHint.mcp: A Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint; the server provides the tools.
connectorHint.openapi: An HTTP API described by an OpenAPI 3.x document; each operation becomes a tool.

wizard.specUrlHelp: Where the OpenAPI document (JSON or YAML) lives; it is read without credentials.
wizard.specFileHelp: JSON or YAML, up to 2 MB.
wizard.specTooLarge: The document is larger than 2 MB.
wizard.baseUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the servers in the document.
wizard.hintHelp: Pick one to fill in the settings below.
wizard.oauthCodeHint: Each member signs in with their own account (personal credential). The kernel needs http.publicUrl configured for the callback URL.
wizard.oauthClientHint: One shared OAuth client obtains tokens for the organization; the client is verified when you install.
wizard.dcrUnsupported: The authorization server does not support automatic client registration. Register a client with the provider and enter its client ID and secret below.
wizard.publicUrlRequired: OAuth apps need http.publicUrl configured on the kernel (it builds the OAuth callback URL). Ask your deployment admin to set it, or use another authentication method.
wizard.operationsHint: Choose the operations agents may use. Default policies follow the HTTP method; you can change them on the app page later.
wizard.toolsHint: These tools come with the app. Default policies follow the tool annotations; you can change them on the app page later.
wizard.toolsAfterInstall: The tools are listed when the app is installed.
wizard.toolsAfterConnect: OAuth authorization-code apps list their tools after the first member connects.
wizard.doneOAuthCode: Each member must connect their own account before agents can use this app on their behalf.
wizard.credentialRequired: Enter the credential; it is used to list the tools when installing.

credentialHint.org: Organization credential: shared by everyone and used to list the tools when installing.
credentialHint.personal: Your own credential: used to list the tools when installing; other members set theirs in My connections later.

connections.empty: No app needs your own credential.

grants.emptyHint: Choosing “Always for this agent” when approving adds one here.

connections.oauthHint: Sign in to this app with your own account; other members use theirs.

policyHint.anonymous: People who have not linked chat as anonymous guests. Only agents visible to the whole organization can be used, and no personal credentials.

form.pluginHint: Channel plugins enabled for this organization.

form.policySectionHint: What happens when someone who has not linked their account messages the bot.

detail.deleteHint: The bot disconnects and stops answering. Conversations already held in IM stay in Capybara.

identities.hint: IM and sign-in accounts linked to your Capybara account. Messages from a linked IM account act as you.
